purpose: Second supplemental macro-fingerprint packet for Sep 3 AI demand and memory-wall additions. Loaded after the existing supplement via the index fetch merger.

stocks.name: Broadcom
stocks.profileNote: Cash-generative custom accelerator/networking leader; primary macro positives are verified AI capex and bandwidth demand, with valuation/customer concentration the rate-sensitive offsets.

industrialCapex.rationale: Custom XPU and networking revenue scales directly with hyperscaler AI infrastructure spend.

memoryBandwidthTightness.rationale: The memory/data-movement wall increases the value of high-bandwidth accelerator and networking architectures, though Broadcom is not a memory vendor.

financialConditions.rationale: Strong FCF limits financing risk, but a premium AI multiple is still sensitive to long real yields.

riskAppetite.rationale: AI semiconductor multiples move with growth/risk appetite.

growthDemand.rationale: Enterprise/cloud activity supports the broader semiconductor and software portfolio.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Advanced packaging and component inflation can pressure supply economics at the margin.

policyRelief.rationale: Easier expected rates mainly help valuation.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Weak-end credit has limited direct effect but can compress semiconductor risk multiples.

stocks.derivedFrom: Sep 3 Broadcom earnings and Power Stack AI-capex/memory research.

stocks.name: Micron Technology
stocks.profileNote: Direct memory-cycle beneficiary with HBM/DRAM/NAND exposure. Memory tightness is strongly positive until capacity additions overshoot demand.

memoryBandwidthTightness.rationale: HBM/DRAM/NAND scarcity and rising AI memory content directly improve utilization, mix and pricing.

industrialCapex.rationale: AI server and accelerator buildout drives memory bits and HBM demand.

growthDemand.rationale: Memory remains cyclical and benefits from broad electronics/cloud demand.

financialConditions.rationale: Cash flow is cycle-sensitive; the equity multiple also responds to real yields.

riskAppetite.rationale: Semiconductor cyclicals rerate with growth appetite.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Fab, equipment and materials inflation can raise production/capex costs.

policyRelief.rationale: Rates are secondary to the memory cycle but affect valuation.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Severe credit stress can hit electronics/server demand and cyclical multiples.

stocks.derivedFrom: Sep 3 SEMICON Taiwan/Micron memory-wall research and current supply evidence.

stocks.name: Credo Technology Group
stocks.profileNote: High-growth AI connectivity beneficiary; data movement and memory fanout are core demand drivers, but valuation and customer concentration raise macro sensitivity.

industrialCapex.rationale: Scale-out AI cluster buildout drives optical/copper interconnect demand.

memoryBandwidthTightness.rationale: Memory fanout and bandwidth constraints directly increase the need for high-speed connectivity and OmniConnect-type architectures.

financialConditions.rationale: High-growth valuation is sensitive to long yields even with a strong balance sheet.

riskAppetite.rationale: Small/mid-cap AI semiconductor multiples are highly sentiment sensitive.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Advanced component and foundry costs can pressure margins.

policyRelief.rationale: Lower rates mainly support the multiple.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Risk-off credit stress compresses premium AI infrastructure multiples.

stocks.derivedFrom: Credo Q1 FY27 earnings plus Sep 3 bandwidth/memory-fanout research.

stocks.name: Dell Technologies
stocks.profileNote: Hard AI order/backlog exposure with more direct component, working-capital and margin sensitivity than semiconductor suppliers.

industrialCapex.rationale: AI server orders/backlog directly reflect funded infrastructure capex.

memoryBandwidthTightness.rationale: Memory scarcity validates demand but constrains server shipment capacity and can pressure bill-of-materials/margins.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Component inflation and shortages raise working capital and pressure hardware margins.

growthDemand.rationale: Enterprise infrastructure modernization supports non-AI server/storage demand.

financialConditions.rationale: Customer capex and Dell's capital structure respond to financing costs.

riskAppetite.rationale: AI systems valuation expands/contracts with tech appetite.

policyRelief.rationale: Lower rates modestly support enterprise capex and valuation.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Credit stress can delay enterprise infrastructure orders and raise financing risk.

stocks.derivedFrom: Dell Q2 FY27 AI orders/backlog and supply-chain evidence.

stocks.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
stocks.profileNote: AI/server/networking exposure is strong, but memory availability, inventory and Juniper integration create material operating sensitivity.

industrialCapex.rationale: Cloud/AI systems and data-center networking scale with infrastructure capex.

memoryBandwidthTightness.rationale: DDR/NAND constraints validate demand but limit shipments, increase inventory and raise component cost.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Component inflation and supply agreements can pressure gross margin and cash conversion.

growthDemand.rationale: Enterprise infrastructure demand supports server, storage and networking.

financialConditions.rationale: Large inventory, acquisition financing and customer capex make yields relevant.

riskAppetite.rationale: AI/networking rerating contributes to equity sensitivity.

policyRelief.rationale: Easier rates support enterprise capex and integration financing.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Credit stress can pressure customer capex and acquisition/working-capital economics.

stocks.derivedFrom: HPE Q3 FY26 results, memory-supply commentary and Juniper integration context.

stocks.name: Snowflake
stocks.profileNote: Application/data-layer AI demand is accelerating, but valuation is strongly duration-sensitive and revenue remains tied to enterprise/cloud consumption.

growthDemand.rationale: Data/cloud workload growth drives consumption revenue.

industrialCapex.rationale: AI investment expands downstream data and application workloads even though Snowflake is not physical capex.

financialConditions.rationale: High-duration software valuation is very sensitive to real yields.

riskAppetite.rationale: Premium software multiples respond strongly to growth appetite and rotations.

tailCreditStress.rationale: Enterprise budget stress and private-tech weakness can reduce consumption and compress multiples.

consumerStrength.rationale: Consumer conditions are an indirect end-demand influence only.

inputCostPressure.rationale: Cloud infrastructure input inflation can modestly affect gross margin economics.

stocks.derivedFrom: Snowflake Q2 FY27 product revenue/RPO and Sep 3 software-versus-semiconductor rotation research.
